text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, happy birthday!! Let's have a 
birthday party!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! By the way, today's lucky 
item is a "white flower"!! Let's decorate 
the party venue with them to invite good 
fortune!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you. But there's no 
need for a party. Your words are more than 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! Parties are super important!! They 
become precious memories, you see!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's a special day that 
brings happiness every time you remember 
it! Even Lord Shiraoki says so!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It would be wonderful if this turns 
into a lovely day we can look back on next 
year, and the year after that...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So... as part of the party, would you run 
with me? With all the power we have right 
now, to our hearts' content.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! The training course lies in an 
auspicious direction!! However, just 
running won't be much different from—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
! Let's gather lots of white flowers! They 
are lucky items, right? We shall 
scatter-sushi them across the training 
course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're going to scatter them around?! That 
sounds so much like a party! Let's gather 
our friends and go collect them right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait...! I feel like that'll just end up 
as a memory of us getting scolded...!
